text: In accordance with Section B.3. of the Terms of Reference of the Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, Transgender, Queer and Two-Spirit (LGBTQ2S+) Advisory Committee, the Committee will elect a member of the public as Co-Chair.

The Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, Transgender, Queer and Two-Spirit Advisory Committee: 1. Elected Laura McPhie as Co-Chair of the Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, Transgender, Queer and Two-Spirit Advisory Committee for a term of office ending on November 14, 2022.
